name_en: Gane-age — julienned sweet potato fried into a crab-leg shape
summary_ja: 拍子切りにしたさつまいもをしょうが入りの甘めの衣にくぐらせ、油で揚げた惣菜。天草の方言で「がね」はカニの意味で、揚げた形がカニの足に似ることから名付けられたという。精進料理としても使われる。
summary_en: Sweet potato cut into batons is coated in a ginger-sweetened batter and deep-fried. "Gane" is Amakusa dialect for crab, said to describe the shape of the fried strands, and the dish also serves as a vegetarian offering at Buddhist services.

name_en: Shaku no tempura — deep-fried mud shrimp eaten whole, shell and all
summary_ja: 干潟の深い巣穴にすむシャク（アナジャコ）に衣をつけ、殻ごとからりと揚げた夏の珍味。鮮度落ちが早く熊本県外にはほとんど流通せず、身も殻も内臓も食べられ濃い味わいが特徴とされる。
summary_en: Shaku, a mud shrimp burrowing deep in tidal flats, is battered and deep-fried shell and all — a summer delicacy that spoils fast enough to rarely leave Kumamoto, eaten whole, shell, meat, and innards, for its intensely rich flavor.
source_title: シャクの天ぷら 熊本県
